label: Bitvavo
instructions: Log in to bitvavo.com → Settings → API → Create new API key.
Give it only the “View” permission. Do not enable trading or withdrawals.
Optionally restrict it to your server's public IP address.
Copy the key and the secret (the secret is shown only once).

label: Kraken
instructions: Log in to kraken.com → Settings → API → Create API key.
Enable only: “Query Funds” and “Query Ledger Entries”. Leave every trading, deposit and withdrawal permission off.
Copy the API key and the private key.

label: Coinbase
instructions: Open the Coinbase Developer Platform (portal.cdp.coinbase.com) → API Keys → Create API key, signed in with your Coinbase account.
Under advanced settings choose the ECDSA signature algorithm (Ed25519 keys are not accepted by the Coinbase App API).
Grant only “View” permissions on your Coinbase App portfolio. No trade or transfer permissions.
Paste the key name (organizations/…/apiKeys/…) and the full private key including the BEGIN/END lines.

label: Interactive Brokers (Flex)
instructions: Client Portal → Performance & Reports → Flex Queries → create an Activity Flex Query.
Sections: Trades (Execution level), Cash Transactions (Detail), Open Positions (Summary) and Cash Report. Select all fields in each.
Format XML, period “Last 365 Calendar Days”. Save and note the Query ID.
Flex Queries page → Flex Web Service Configuration → enable it and generate a token.
The Flex service only covers up to 365 days per query; import older history via CSV.
LYNX accounts are Interactive Brokers accounts: the same steps should work in LYNX's portal, where the token may be under Account Settings → Reporting. Not tested with LYNX yet.

label: Bitpanda
instructions: Bitpanda → Account settings → API Keys → New API key (or app.bitpanda.com/my-account/apikey).
Tick only the read scopes: Balances, Transaction and Trade (Read). Not Trade (Write) or Earn (Write): with those a key can trade.
Set an expiry date (at most a year) and paste the key here; Bitpanda shows it only once.
Built on Bitpanda's documentation and not yet tested with a real key: check the balances after the first sync.
